# Gotchas (all pages)

**Generated by `python tools/gen_kb_index.py` - do not edit here.** Each trap lives in the
`## Gotchas` section of its topic page; fix or add it there and regenerate. 249 traps, symptom
first. Search it for what you are seeing (`python tools/kb.py search "<symptom>"` covers it too).

## Mod structure, packaging and load order

From [mod-structure.md](mod-structure.md#gotchas).

- **Mod loads but nothing changes:** the pak has a wrapping folder (`src/Libs/...`). Open it and check the top level is `Libs/`/`Scripts/` (tutorial episode 1, verified in game).
- **Every Workshop mod stopped loading** after you added one line to `mod_order.txt`: unlisted mods, Workshop included, are not loaded at all (official wiki KM-A-56).
- **Mod disabled after a game patch** although it "supports 1.2.*": major versions have no patch number; write `1.2*` (official wiki KM-A-57).
- **Your table patch replaced a whole vanilla file** instead of patching it: your modid equals a reserved table-part name such as `horse` or `perk` (official wiki KM-A-35).
- **Works in the Modding Tools, does nothing in retail:** loose files. Pack them (official wiki KM-A-58).
- **Workshop mod not loading in the dev build:** by design; different Steam app (official wiki KM-A-55).
- **Log full of "hash clash" / `dupe/clash detection` lines:** localization file not named `<anything>__<modid>.xml` (official wiki KM-A-91).
- **Raw string key on screen:** the row is missing from a language file you ship (verified in game). The English fallback covers a missing language pak (official wiki KM-A-91), apparently not a missing row (inferred). See [Localization](mod-structure.md#localization-text).
- **Mod manager crashes on your mod:** manifest without `encoding="utf-8"` (community, unverified which managers).
- **Vanilla NPCs lost their lipsync** after installing your mod: you shipped a partial `FacialAnimations.img`; it replaces vanilla's whole index (lipsync.md).
- **A Warhorse bugfix never reached your players:** you ship an override of that file (quest XML, AI XML); regenerate it after each patch (quest-override-battles.md).
- **Upload to Workshop fails:** cover image over 1 MB (official wiki KM-A-85).

## Lua scripting

From [lua-scripting.md](lua-scripting.md#gotchas).

- **A command, timer or BT hook "does nothing" in retail.** A Lua error inside it was swallowed.
  Wrap bodies in `xpcall` with `debug.traceback`, and reproduce in the dev build
  ([debugging.md](debugging.md#reading-lua-errors)).
- **A whole module's functions are `nil`.** The file failed to compile (a BOM, a stray `end`), or it
  was never `Script.LoadScript`ed. Lua 5.1 does not skip a UTF-8 BOM.
- **Gameplay setup at the top level of the init script finds `player == nil`.** That code runs at
  the main menu. Move it into `OnGameplayStarted`.
- **A loop runs 2×, 3×, N× too often after several loads, or a long save stutters.** Pending
  `SetTimerForFunction` timers were restored from the save and bypassed your arm-once guard. Put the
  load generation in the timer function name.
- **A loop never starts again after the second load in one session.** A `Running=true` latch
  survived the load, but the chain it guarded did not. Clear latches at the top of
  `OnGameplayStarted`.
- **A timer chain silently stops re-firing.** A third argument was passed to
  `Script.SetTimerForFunction`.
- **A "restore" timer taken across a save never restores after a relaunch.** It named a run-time
  closure that no longer exists; persist the state and redo it on load.
- **A cooldown never expires again after loading a save.** A `System.GetCurrTime` mark from the
  previous session survived in a Lua table; the clock restarted. Clear marks on load.
- **A cached entity is "still there" after a load, but it is someone else.** Entity ids are recycled;
  re-resolve by name.
- **A `self`-using callback errors on "attempt to index nil".** Timer and command targets are
  called by name without `self`.
- **Cooldowns expire instantly during sleep or fast travel.** Timers and `GetCurrTime` run on the
  accelerated engine clock. Use `os.clock()` for real-world durations.
- **Timing inside one frame reads 0 ms.** `System.GetCurrTime()` is frame-cached. Use `os.clock()`.
- **Every `LoadString` returns nil after crossing Trosky ↔ Kuttenberg.** The saver entity lives in
  the other level. Carry state in a Lua global.
- **Removing the mod makes a save refuse to load ("Load of game has failed").** An entity of a
  mod-defined class is in that save. Flag such entities `ENTITY_FLAG_NO_SAVE`.
- **An instance `OnSave`/`OnLoad` override never fires.** They are cached on the class. Use a
  field the vanilla class already serialises.
- **`SetFlags(x, 1)` wipes an entity's flags.** Mode 1 is AND-mask; add is mode 0.
- **A custom entity's `OnUpdate` never runs.** It must be `Client:OnUpdate` or `Server:OnUpdate`,
  with `ent:Activate(1)`.
- **`System.SpawnEntity` kills the calling command with no log line.** The class has no `.ent`
  file. The call throws, so wrap it in `pcall` and log the failure.
- **A GUID lookup with `string.find` fails or matches the wrong thing.** `-` is a pattern magic
  character. Use `string.find(s, guid, 1, true)`, or better, a hash set keyed by GUID.
- **`MakeUsable` silently replaces your `OnUsed`.** Call `EntityCommon.MakeUsable` before defining
  the class's own handlers.

## Debugging and testing

From [debugging.md](debugging.md#gotchas).

- **The game freezes or deadlocks in a behaviour tree.** Either a `Loop` has no non-zero `Wait`, or
  a latent node (`Wait`, `Move`, `Turn`) sits inside an `AtomicDecorator`
  ([behavior-trees.md](behavior-trees.md), [basic-structure.md](../behaviour-trees/basic-structure.md#concurrency)).
- **A native crash with a 0-byte minidump.** A mount was `RemoveEntity`d in the same frame its rider
  was dismounted. Remove a horse only once it is confirmed unmounted, several polls later (verified
  in game, travel-detection.md).
- **The game crashes when the map opens.** Map POI markers with low ids (1, 2) collide with vanilla
  clip depths. Use ids ≥ 9001 (map-marker.md, [ui-scaleform.md](ui-scaleform.md)).
- **A crash on `LoadCharacter`.** KCD2 ships no `.cdf`/`.chr` files, so vanilla-style character paths
  do not exist (npc-lod.md).
- **A switching behaviour tree crashes on `Move`.** `changeNPCState="true"` is not allowed in a
  Switching-type tree ([movement.md](../behaviour-trees/movement.md)).
- **A save will not load after the mod is removed ("Load of game has failed").** An entity of a
  mod-defined class is in the save ([lua-scripting.md](lua-scripting.md#persistence-and-saving)).
- **The game quits during init with nothing useful in the log.** It was launched directly without
  `steam_appid.txt`.
- **A console command does nothing and logs nothing (retail).** Its body threw a Lua error.
  Reproduce in the dev build, where it logs `[Lua Error] ... [string ""]:1:`.
- **A command always uses its default argument.** The `%line` quoting: `tonumber('"5"')` is `nil`.
- **A quest silently stops working (retail).** A Skald node was rejected. Only the dev build's
  `kcd.log` names it, and one bad node can take down the mod's entire quest graph.
- **Stutter that grows across save-scumming, then bursts after fast travel.** Duplicate timer chains
  were restored from the save ([lua-scripting.md](lua-scripting.md#timers-and-saves)).
- **A mod-bound F-key logs "bound" and then does nothing.** The game owns that key.
- **The UI draws nothing, with no error.** Most Scaleform mistakes produce no log line at all. Check
  statically before launching (ui-building.md, [ui-scaleform.md](ui-scaleform.md)).
- **Conclusions drawn from an old run.** The log was stale: the dev build's copy of the mod was weeks
  old and nobody checked the file's modified time. Several research runs were invalidated
  (npc-lod.md).
- **An event you know fired N times shows up once.** Identical consecutive log lines are collapsed.
- **Performance numbers from the dev build are wildly worse than players report.** It is the wrong
  build to measure.
- **An A/B test "proves" two different culprits on two days.** The fault was intermittent (corrupted
  game files). Single-run A/B tests on a coin-flip fault prove nothing.
- **A "with/without mod" comparison is meaningless.** The save carries entities or state from mods
  that are no longer installed (`Mods used while saving`).
- **A fixture broke its own test.** A helper named "force render" set the ratio to 254 and then 0 on
  the next line, and a whole approach was abandoned on that evidence. Sanity-check the instrument
  first (npc-lod.md).
- **A guessed asset path "proves" the asset does not exist.** Wrong guesses fail silently and look
  exactly like a missing asset. Grep the extracted data for real names
  (siege-builder.md).

## Behaviour trees (XGEN / MBT) reference

From [behavior-trees.md](behavior-trees.md#gotchas).

- **Game freezes or hangs** when a `Loop` contains no latent node (`Wait`, `Move`, a gate...). 77 of
  1,104 vanilla loops have none because they rely on a latent child elsewhere; do not copy that
  without understanding it (public guide + vanilla census).
- **Tree deadlocks / engine freezes** when `Wait`, `Move`, `Turn` or another latent node sits inside
  `AtomicDecorator`. Vanilla never does it (0 of 376) (public guide, old context doc).
- **Lua node spams "Can't run uncompilable lua code"** when a `--` comment sits on a raw line break
  in `code`. Use `&#10;` or `--[[ ]]`.
- **A typo'd attribute does nothing** and loads without error; vanilla itself passes undeclared
  attributes to `Function_` calls (verified in game: aleksej). `LogToConsole` takes
  `Message`, not `text`.
- **A `_wuid` never reads back as nil in Lua** once set, and `data.x = nil` does not clear it. Clear
  with `Expression "$x = $__null"` and test nulls tree-side; publish a separate bool from Lua when
  Lua owns validity (verified in game: quartermaster,
  formations).
- **NPC stands still after `AddInterrupt_attack`** when the `Behavior` name has no
  `SmartBehaviorTemplate`; if the tree's "already fired" flag is set regardless, it retries forever
  silently.
- **Behaviour dies right after starting** when another arm queues an interrupt in the same window
  (interrupts land a tick later). Scope re-kicks to NPCs that need them, and stagger them.
- **Loop free-runs during sleep** when paced by a long `GameTime` wait.
- **A stopped NPC freezes at a point** with `Move changeNPCState="false"`; that value is for
  continuously following a moving actor. `changeNPCState="true"` inside a Switching tree reportedly
  crashes it (community guide, `(unverified)`).
- **A pose keeps playing after the tree is torn down** when held with `UnstanceAction` (it returns
  immediately). Use `UnstanceElement` or `StanceElement` around the hold.
- **Multi-waypoint walker halts at every point** when a `Loop` re-issues `Move` at the point it just
  reached; aim ahead instead. Shrinking the arrival radius makes `Move` fail, and inside a
  `Parallel failureMode="Any"` takes the whole tree down (verified in game:
  walls-and-sieges).
- **`Move` to a spawned `BasicEntity` does nothing**: `BasicEntity` is not AI-targetable. Move to a
  `vec3` instead (verified in game: camp).
- **Many NPCs lag-spike together** when they share a tree with an un-varied `Wait`.
- **A scheduler stops re-firing a behaviour after some fights but not others**: a latch (`$isIdleActive`-style bool) is
  cleared by only one of the paths into the state it guards. Clear it wherever the state is entered, e.g. in the
  combat-detection loop as well as in the arm that starts a fight (verified in game:
  quartermaster).
- **A follower dashes to re-acquire its station over and over**: a time-boxed `CrimeFollower` is being restarted; it never
  returns on its own, so end it on a change of state, not a timer (bandit-camp-quest).

## AI brains, souls and NPCs

From [ai-brains-and-npcs.md](ai-brains-and-npcs.md#gotchas).

- **NPC spawns with no soul, inventory or brain, and no error**: wrong property key (`sharedSoulGuid`)
  or an `s`-prefixed GUID.
- **T-posed NPC right after spawn**: `class` does not match `soul_archetype_id`.
- **NPC stands still, never fights**: interrupt behaviour not registered in a SmartEntity, or its
  template is `InitialState="Disabled"`.
- **Vanilla NPCs ignore your hostile faction**: relations are one-directional.
- **Corpses of your bandits prompt "Rob" and loot is stolen**: faction lacks `Labels="publicEnemy"`.
- **NPC spawns naked or partially dressed**: no preset applied first, `RequiresFilledSlot` order,
  two items in one slot, or a quest item.
- **NPC invisible from spawn**: DLC-only head without the DLC (e.g. `m_head_painter`), or an
  unsafe `body_type`. See [NPC rendering and LOD](npc-rendering-and-lod.md#content-that-renders-nothing).
- **Polearm NPC looks unarmed**: sheathed polearms do not render.
- **NPC keeps sitting while walking/fighting**: pose held by `UnstanceAction`.
- **Dialogue E-prompt dead or laggy**: no `dialogMailbox` handler in the tree, or polled too slowly.
- **`Move` to a spawned marker does nothing**: `BasicEntity` is not AI-targetable. Move to a `vec3`.
- **Female soldier stands inert in combat**: no female combat pipeline exists.
- **SoulDeathTrigger never fires** for Lua-spawned NPCs. Poll instead.

## Combat, crime and perception

From [combat-and-perception.md](combat-and-perception.md#gotchas).

- **NPC stands still when told to attack**: the `Behavior` has no `SmartBehaviorTemplate`, or the
  target was re-fired every tick (each re-fire replays entry and draw).
- **Fresh enemies swing with fists for seconds**: `WeaponChange="none"`. Use `melee`/`missile`.
- **30% of a battle stands idle but visible**: empty weapon set. Grep the log for `explicit DrawAction`.
- **Fighters approach in step-pause-step**: `CombatAction` inside a `Loop`, a missing
  `CombatMoveDecorator`, or target churn re-firing the interrupt.
- **Custom squad turns on guards**: a relationship test that treats anything below 1 as hostile, or
  one that does not separate "wanted player" from "outlaw". Only `-1` plus a label or faction test.
- **Squad charges villagers**: `GetTarget` on the player without a weapon-drawn check.
- **Town watch ignores a fight between mod NPCs**: no reverse faction relation exists, and nobody
  emits `crime_emitInformation`.
- **Enemies flee before contact against a big squad**: vanilla morale headcount term. See
  [morale](combat-and-perception.md#morale-why-enemies-run).
- **Everyone reads as "not targeted"**: code relies on `soul:GetTarget()`, which does not exist.
- **Combat-feel cvars "don't work"**: they do take effect, and still change nothing visible. Do not
  rebuild that experiment.
- **Mercy kill never offered to NPC logic**: player-only engine rule.
- **Permanent `Battle` context kills all dialogue** (npc-lod).

## Formations (engine system)

From [formations.md](formations.md#gotchas).

- **Followers stand still or trail as a blob with no error:** the "leader" is the player or an entity whose
  tree never ran `MakeFormation`; `GetMemberFormation` returns null and the null guard swallows it.
- **A formation type from Skald is silently loose:** an unrecognised `formationType` (typo, wrong case)
  falls into the bridge `Switch`'s `DefaultBranch` and becomes `Relaxed`.
- **`PreferredPositions` from a struct does nothing:** the struct member is `preferedPosition` (one `r`,
  singular); the node attribute is `PreferredPositions`.
- **Followers are stranded after a shape change:** `EndFormation` + `MakeFormation` minted a new handle;
  use `ChangeFormation`, run as a `Parallel` sibling of the leader's movement.
- **A copied formation node never runs:** it came from `<ForestContainer>` (editor scratch), not `<Root>`.
- **Second encounter deadlocks the first:** a `Global` lock with a fixed name; template it on the shared
  subject's WUID.
- **Lock name reads as `$x_suffix` literally or as the wrong variable:** single-quoted strings interpolate;
  terminate the variable with `;` before a suffix (`'$lock;_sweetSpot'`).
- **Re-running a behaviour skips the "wait for leader" phase:** `Local` open vs `Global` close lock
  mismatch (vanilla `vezniNaTroskach.xml` ships this); pair the manager types.
- **A dead leader leaves the whole formation frozen:** vanilla never re-elects (the battle election is a
  one-shot latch); re-elect yourself.
- **Vanilla formations vanish game-wide after installing a mod:** its `FormationDefinitions.xml` override
  dropped presets, or is from an older game build.

## NPC rendering, LOD and invisible NPCs

From [npc-rendering-and-lod.md](npc-rendering-and-lod.md#gotchas).

- **NPCs invisible only in main-quest battles**: nothing in the battle targets them. Not fixable
  with LOD cvars.
- **Force-unhiding gives T-posed, teleporting NPCs**: that fights the per-frame LOD hide. `Hide(0)`
  alone is only the render half.
- **"View distance fix did nothing"**: check that no later call resets the ratio (`254` then `0`).
- **Characters look like clay up close**: `SetLodRatio(255)` on a character, or crowd-driven mesh
  LOD bands.
- **Budget boost undone within ~300 ms or on entering a town**: CVarOverride re-applied the context
  `.cfg`. Re-assert while active.
- **A permanent `Battle` game context disables all NPC dialogue.**
- **One `QuestVisual` (or other non-instantiable node) takes down the entire mod quest graph**, and
  only the dev build names it.
- **Raising `MaxCountDetail` to 300+ hurts framerate** more than it helps.
- **A stuck-looking NPC may be in the LOD tier**, not buggy: with over 70 NPCs around, it moves in
  jumps by design.
- **Reading one behaviour's heartbeat as "the AI is dead"** is wrong while another branch (combat)
  runs.

## Skald quests and dialogue

From [skald-quests-dialog.md](skald-quests-dialog.md#gotchas).

- **Every mod dialogue stopped working at once:** one node in the graph failed to load (`Namespace`, `QuestVisual`, unwired required port). Only the dev build log says which (npc-lod.md).
- **Dialogue ends right after a response instead of branching:** the sequence that nests a `Decision` lacks `EndType="Decision"` (old context doc, verified in game).
- **`Decision with alias 'x' was not found!`:** the dialogue is imported with `<Definition>` but has no instance node in `<Nodes>`; the alias is not misspelled (aleksej.md).
- **Forced dialogue request times out:** the NPC is off navmesh (`fader`/`ingame` presets walk participants) (aleksej.md).
- **Token grant does nothing:** the token item row is missing from `item__<modid>.xml` (Mercenaries `TODO.txt`, verified in game).
- **Quest reward pays a tenth of the purse, and the notification agrees:** `CreatePlayerReward` money `Amount` is in decigroschen; multiply groschen by 10 (aleksej.md).
- **Chat menu closes by itself after a few seconds:** `TimeLimit`/`DefaultChatTimeLimit` is not `0` (order-wheel.md).
- **Player receives two tokens:** two `EventFunction` nodes with near-identical names are wired to the same Out-port; both fire, no conflict error (old context doc, verified in game).
- **Repeatable quest completes instantly on the next run:** a stale Lua→Skald token was left in the inventory (bandit-camp-quest.md).
- **Quest marker points at nothing after a reload:** it bound to the pre-reload entity; adopt the saved NPC by name at wake (aleksej.md).
- **Objective never updates when your spawned NPC dies:** `SoulDeathTrigger` ignores Lua-spawned souls; poll in Lua and send a token (aleksej.md).
- **Chat menu never shows on a follower:** the follow hint owns the interaction slot, or another chat won the clash (order-wheel.md).
- **An effect node's output reads garbage:** you read its data port outside the tick its trigger fired; feed live data from `ObjectProperties` (bandit-camp-quest.md).
- **An unrecognised enum constant in a port silently becomes the default** (e.g. a typo'd formation type becomes `Relaxed`) ([formations.md](formations.md#formationmode-and-the-params-struct)).
- **`SpawnFriend`/`SpawnEnemy` ignores your soul GUID:** vanilla `CombatDebug` wants `s<guid>` (37 characters; `a`/`w` prefixes for armour/weapon presets); a bare GUID is not recognised (vanilla: `Scripts/Debug/CombatDebug.lua`). Precedence note: the old context doc (section 9.6) claims the opposite, that the `s` prefix breaks spawning; vanilla source wins. Everywhere else (`SharedSoulGuids`, `guidSharedSoulId`) GUIDs are bare.
- **A dialogue works in the Modding Tools build and not in retail:** console commands from Skald and lenient error handling exist only there ([how-to-mod.md](../general/how-to-mod.md), community).
- **You overrode a vanilla quest file and a later patch "undid" nothing but broke something:** overrides freeze at the build you copied; regenerate after every game patch (quest-override-battles.md).

## Data tables (the game database)

From [data-tables.md](data-tables.md#gotchas).

- **An item is silently missing from an NPC's preset while the rest arrives:** it is `IsQuestItem="true"`; presets never grant quest items and nothing logs it (weapon-audit.md, companions.md, verified in game).
- **The cuirass never equips, no error:** its slot `RequiresFilledSlot` an underlayer that is empty (custom-gear.md).
- **A hand-dressed NPC wears two outfits at once:** per-piece equipping leaves the preset's other slots filled; `UnequipItemInSlot` them (aleksej.md).
- **A reward pays a tenth of what you wrote:** money `Amount` in `CreatePlayerReward` is decigroschen ([Money](data-tables.md#money)).
- **Money transfer "succeeds" and nothing arrives:** `move_money` from an empty purse, or `inventory:AddMoney`, which retail does not bind ([Money](data-tables.md#money)).
- **An NPC is half-dressed:** two items in the clothing preset share a slot, so neither is equipped ([add-new-npc.md](../xml/add-new-npc.md)).
- **Old-table patch wiped fields to defaults:** old tables need the full row in the patch (official wiki KM-A-12).
- **Patch loads but changes nothing:** you patched a table part (`InventoryPreset__player`) instead of the base table, or the file name's modid differs from the manifest (official wiki KM-A-17).
- **Inventory preset patch ignored on an old build:** patching presets needs 1.3+ (official wiki KM-A-90).
- **Your "patch" replaced a vanilla file:** your modid equals a reserved part name (official wiki KM-A-35).
- **Two items fight over one GUID after copy-pasting a vanilla row:** change the `Id`; the official walkthrough warns duplicates break things (official wiki KM-A-17, exact symptom unverified).
- **An RPG constant edit has no effect:** it is recomputed at runtime after load (`CombatAuto*`), or it was an override case that did not apply; read `modified:` in the patch log line (enemy-morale.md).
- **Vanilla NPCs ignore your hostile faction:** relations are one-directional (npc-lod.md).
- **A second SmartEntity file's behaviour "was not available":** templates with the same registry name do not merge across files (Mercenaries `TODO.txt`, claimed).
- **Lua GUID match never succeeds:** you used `string.find` without the plain flag (community).
- **A table edit made in a running dev session does nothing:** tables load once at startup (official wiki KM-A-12).

## Audio, voice lines and lipsync

From [audio-voice-lipsync.md](audio-voice-lipsync.md#gotchas).

- **Custom line shows a subtitle but is silent:** wrong folder (namespace path), wrong prefix (not the speaker's `voice.xml` abbreviation), or you reused a vanilla StringName without copying its `.ogg` (kleinkrieg-voice-lines.md, [add-new-npc.md](../xml/add-new-npc.md)).
- **Dialogue with an unvoiced role hangs, then times out:** add `SelectedSouls` and `VoiceoverFallbackLevel` (mod `aleksej_dialog.xml`).
- **Every merc sounds like the same actor (or a woman):** a borrowed line exists as one take copied under several prefixes (squad-orders.md).
- **Custom line plays with a frozen face:** no facial clip of that name in the index (lipsync.md).
- **After installing your mod, vanilla NPCs' lips stop moving:** you shipped an index without its clips, or a partial index (lipsync.md).
- **Lipsync build "succeeds" but nothing moves:** audio was staged flat, so index paths point nowhere (lipsync.md).
- **No lipsync at all while testing in the dev build:** it has no `Data/Facials`; junction it or test in retail (lipsync.md).
- **New vanilla dialogue lost its face after a game patch:** your shipped index predates it; regenerate (lipsync.md).
- **A female-voiced NPC is silent when hit or killed:** its soul is archetype 0, so Storm gives it the
  `_MUZ` combat roles; swap them for the `_ZENA` twins (female-mercenaries.md).
- **Barks spam after sleeping:** `GameTime` waits expire instantly during time skips (interior-detection.md).
- **Subtitles run too fast or cut off:** `ReferenceLength` missing or shorter than the take; recompute after trimming audio (voice-mastering.md).

## Scaleform UI

From [ui-scaleform.md](ui-scaleform.md#gotchas).

- UI element appears then "disappears" -> you passed a multiplier to `SetScale`/`SetAlpha`; they take percent (100 = 1.0).
- Layout calls do nothing the first time a screen opens -> the movie is built on first display; defer the first layout.
- Your `.swf` never loads -> `wh_gfx_useSWF` was not set in `user.cfg` before launch, the XML names `.swf` instead of
  `.gfx`, or a `.gfx` of the same name exists in the VFS; new elements also need a full restart.
- Clips snap back to their authored place a moment after you move them -> the SWF timeline loops; add `ActionStop`.
- Only the last digit of `500` shows -> one clip instance was placed twice; use one instance per character position.
- `2 / 6` renders as `2 6` -> the glyph set lacks a clip for that separator (it is silently skipped).
- Every uncentred clip sits half its size down-right -> the driver assumed centre registration.
- Listener gets garbage arguments -> callback declared with `.` instead of `:`; `argTable` is 0-indexed.
- Marker added twice / handlers fire twice -> listeners re-registered each `OnGameplayStarted` without `UnregisterElementListener`.
- Game crashes on opening the map -> two POI markers with low ids (1, 2) and loading textures; use ids 9001+, one per call.
- All vanilla map POIs vanish -> `RemovePoiMarkers` takes no argument and clears the whole container.
- Custom map icon draws nothing -> DDS is `BC3_TYPELESS` / `arraySize 0`; write legacy DXT5 or BC7.
- `SendInfoText` prints the raw key -> the key needs a row in all `localization/*_xml.xml` files (and `ElementTree.write`
  strips their comments - splice rows textually).
- `DrawText` renders magenta nonsense -> you used the documented 2012 signature; use `(x, y, text, size, r, g, b, a)`.
- `Draw2DLine` draws a huge white shape in the world -> it wants normalised 0..1 coordinates, not pixels.
- `DrawText` stopped rendering -> `r_AuxGeomAutoScaleOver1080pWH` was set to 0.
- Immediate-mode drawing shows nothing -> `OnUpdate` defined on the entity table instead of `Client`/`Server`, or the `.ent` is missing.
- `SetBubbleText` strobes -> it restarts the bubble animation; only call it when the text changes.
- Keys bound to a screen do nothing -> the command is a dev-gated/lazily registered command, or a `DevCommand`.
- Pressing 1-4 on your screen draws a sword -> hold `no_qam_weapons` via Skald `FilterInput` while the screen is up.
- Player can't draw weapons / move after a crash -> a filter token or disabled action map leaked; clear both
  unconditionally at every `OnGameplayStarted`.
- Suppressing `open_menu` does nothing -> `pure_include` maps cannot be toggled; only `player` can, and it takes mouse look.
- A screen reopens by itself after loading a save -> a pending `SetTimerForFunction` watchdog was serialised into the
  save; cap watchdogs and reset their state at gameplay start.
- Second custom screen draws wrong once the first has been opened -> both elements sit loaded on the same layer.
- Text in panels looks thin and "moddy" -> vanilla list rows are ~27 units on a 1280 stage, body text pure white.

## Assets pipeline

From [assets-pipeline.md](assets-pipeline.md#gotchas).

- Compiled `.cgf` has no material / no collision in game -> `MtlName` says `default`; patch it or `SetMaterial` at spawn.
- `MtlName` patch "didn't stick" and collision is gone -> rc.exe was still writing; wait for the output to settle, then patch.
- A piece cut from a vanilla wall looks like different stone -> vertex colours (blend alpha) were lost on an OBJ round trip.
- Tiled wall shows a thin gap at every joint -> pitch taken from the bounding box; use the commonest body cross-section.
- The end of a wall run is see-through -> vanilla kit pieces are open shells at the ends; cap them or end on a tower.
- A compiler switch "has no effect" -> RC silently ignores misspelled switches; check the exact name.
- Your object is called `Merged` -> node merging is on by default; pass `/mergeallnodes` deliberately or not at all.
- Trim/proxy faces render with the wrong material after compile -> RC compacted unused slots; remap names to fixed slots.
- A wall piece is invisible in game but fine in Blender -> a proxy face coincided with a render face and the weld kept
  the `Nodraw` one; inset the hull.
- Whole mesh vanished after a boolean -> non-closed target or compound cutter under EXACT; FAST leaves cutter debris.
- Second material on a mesh doesn't render -> one visible material per `.cgf`.
- Everything reads submaterial 0 when parsing a `.cgfm` -> mesh-subset stride is 36 bytes.
- Decoded normal maps look speckled -> they are `BC5_SNORM`; decode as signed.
- Mesh enumeration misses files -> you scanned `Objects-part*.pak`; only `IPL_Objects-part*.pak` contain `.cgf`.
- A "wall" mesh tiles whole castles on top of each other -> it is a baked level slice; check the node count.
- Spawned decoration is solid / NPCs stand on stools -> `BasicEntity` defaults to a rigid body; pass `Physics` explicitly.
- Player walks through a spawned mesh that has a proxy -> spawn `properties` lacked `Physics`; else use hidden crate colliders.
- A spawned prop lands on the roof -> spawns snap to the topmost surface over (x, y).
- Smart object / bed a quarter turn off its mesh -> `orientation` (direction vector) and `SetAngles` (yaw) have different zeros.
- Ghost/preview prop never appears -> `object_Model` path typo; nothing errors.
- Use prompt never appears on a custom class -> `EntityCommon.MakeUsable` overwrote your `IsUsable`.
- Game crashes on use -> `OnUsed` destroyed its own entity inline; defer a tick.

## World and physics

From [world-and-physics.md](world-and-physics.md#gotchas).

- Everything the mod built "vanished" after fast travel -> the player crossed into the other level; entities are per level.
- Saved state reads nil after a region crossing -> saver entities stayed in the other level; carry state in Lua globals.
- `GetCurrLevelName` returns "" -> no level-name API works on this build; identify the level from `RPG.GetLocations()` names.
- A reloaded structure moved a few metres -> geometry was still streaming when the ground search re-ran.
- A marker/structure appears in the wrong place on the other map -> both levels share one coordinate space.
- Ground check passes everything -> `System.GetTerrainElevation` returns nil; use an `ent_terrain` ray.
- Props land on woodpiles/tents/roofs -> first-hit-wins raycast; compare `surface` with the terrain ray's.
- Ray can't see carts, barrels, corpses -> mask 257 excludes rigid bodies; use 263.
- Multi-hit ray returns one hit -> it does not pierce; cast separately masked rays.
- `renderNode`/`entity` fields misclassify terrain -> `renderNode` is set on terrain too; only `surface` discriminates.
- Player reads "outdoors" inside a castle or your own tent -> `interior` covers prefab buildings only.
- `System.IsPointIndoors` always false -> no VisAreas in KCD2 levels.
- Fast-travel detector never fires -> `GetWorldTimeRatio` is always 15; the `realTimeDelta` guard never passes at 1 Hz;
  `GetHorse()` is ownership; measure the clock rate and the mover's own speed.
- Riding triggers the "carried" detector -> the rider's speed is 0 in the saddle; test the horse's own `GetSpeed()`.
- Mounted detection always says "on foot" -> `System.GetEntity(wuid)` returns nil; use `XGenAIModule.GetEntityByWUID`.
- A 3 s cooldown expires instantly during travel -> `System.GetCurrTime` is warped; use `os.clock()` for real-time holds.
- Something spawned while the player was on the map screen -> no detector can see a trip before it starts; gate on player movement.
- BT watcher loop runs wild after sleeping -> `Wait timeType="GameTime"` expires instantly during time skips.
- Slow motion wears off after ~10 s -> the engine restores `t_GameScale`; re-assert it every second.
- NPCs walk through your walls while the player cannot -> `ac_disableLivingVsRigidCollisions` is on; pulse collider mode with it off.
- NPCs press against your wall and stay -> the navmesh never contains runtime geometry; route them yourself.
- `wh_ai_RebuildNavmesh` does nothing -> it is a stub; the navmesh is baked.
- `bUsedAsDynamicObstacle` has no effect -> the entity is `PE_STATIC`; the obstacle query only sees rigid bodies.
- Only some of a long wall is avoided -> the global obstacle pool has 32 slots; merge runs into one obstacle each.
- Collision mask stops working after a save/load -> masks don't survive re-physicalisation; re-apply on a sweep.
- Tagging `gcc_horse` didn't stop mount collisions -> measure what class the ridden horse carries.
- Native crash with no callstack while moving a mounted company -> a horse was removed in the same frame its rider was
  dismounted; move the horse instead, defer any removal.
- Teleported rider is back where he was a moment later -> another system re-mounted him on the horse left behind; move the horse.
- `wh_ai_DisableORCAInBattle` change has no effect -> it is latched on game-context transitions only.
- Ray ignores your skip entity and hits the caster, with a warning per ray -> you passed the entity table; pass `ent.id`.
- Placement probe never sees the bush growing through your prop -> vegetation has no physics proxy; bake it offline.
- `GetEntitiesInSphere` finds nothing where it found something before -> it is unreliable on repeat calls; keep a fallback.
- A prop's tilt never applies -> it was physicalized first; set angles before `PhysicalizeThis()`.
- A borrowed level entity's "home" is wrong after a load -> the engine restored it where you moved it; save the home.

## Engine internals

From [engine-internals.md](engine-internals.md#gotchas).

- **A native plugin reads a random pointer and crashes after a patch.** The `gEnv` RVA was hardcoded
  or gated on the version string. Resolve it by signature on every launch.
- **A runtime signature scan finds nothing on 1.4+.** It uses the pre-1.4 byte pattern. Scan for
  both patterns.
- **Every Lua write from a native plugin "succeeds" and nothing happens.** The plugin called vtable
  slot 7 (`UnloadScript`) believing it was `ExecuteBuffer`. Use slot 6, and confirm slots from the
  function body.
- **The `CompleteInit` hook never fires.** The DLL was injected after init. Register directly after a
  grace period.
- **Behaviour or timings measured in the dev build do not match retail.** It is a different DLL
  layout, a non-PGO build and an older game version.
- **A cvar default reads 0 in the disassembly.** It sits in uninitialised `.data` and is assigned at
  runtime. Read it live.
- **A "call" found in the corpus is dead code, or a function has no callers.** The corpus is static,
  and virtual calls are not in `calls`. Check `xrefs` on the vtable, and prove behaviour in game.

## Console variables

From [console-variables.md](console-variables.md#gotchas).

- A cvar with `default` blank in `data/cvars.tsv` is not necessarily undocumented -- many real defaults are computed at runtime and are not recoverable as a literal from the registration call-site (see `data/README.md`).
- `registered_in` function names (`sub_XXXXXXX`) are RVAs for build `release_1_5_1308617_856` only -- they will not match after a game patch. Re-run `tools/gen_cvar_reference.py` after any corpus rebuild rather than hardcoding one elsewhere.
- The disasm corpus's own `cvars` table includes some strings that merely look cvar-shaped (log tags, format strings) -- see `E:\kcd2_disasm\AGENTS.md`. A `kind` of `unknown` with zero `registered_in` hits is likely one of these.
- `docs/mercenaries/ai/combat-movement.md` documents roughly forty combat-movement cvars with verified stock values from in-game testing -- prefer those over this generator's `default` column when they overlap; this generator does not currently merge that table in (see `data/README.md`).
- **632 cvars with an upper-case-starting name** (e.g. `WH_AI_CombatMove_TacticalSurround`) are registered in `WHGame.dll` but invisible to the disasm corpus's own `cvars` table, which only ever captures lowercase-starting names -- this generator recovers them separately (`source` = `harvested (...)` in `data/cvars.tsv`). Prefixes seen: `WH_` (240), `ui_` (46), `pad_` (32), `demo_` (25), `xi_` (17), `r_` (16), `aim_` (14), `gfx_` (14).
